acceptance_criteria: repeated-run byte equality and no-mutation checks; CHK-17, NEG-25.
statement: The journal status vocabulary **shall** be closed, enumerable, and deterministically ordered; the same operation sequence **shall** produce the same primary status, the same frame bytes, and the same recovery summary across repeated bounded runs, and a failure **shall** leave the retained count, retained bytes, and index unchanged except for a declared boundary restoration.
title: T026 requirement 016
verification_intent: repeated-run byte equality and no-mutation checks; CHK-17, NEG-25.
